Caleb: hey team, Caleb here — first week! Opening my first PR in `console` and want to make sure I follow our expectations. Quick q: branch naming, tests to run locally, and reviewer etiquette? :wave:
Rhea: welcome Caleb :tada: branch pattern is `fix/` `feat/` `chore/` + initials, e.g. `fix/ca/bug-serialize`. Keep it short.
Mira: tests: run `make test && ./scripts/run-smoke` for a fast local sanity check. For anything touching models or runtime routing run the integration subset: `./scripts/integration --tags runtime`.
Caleb: thanks. PR size guidance? mine is ~350 LOC but most is a test fixture.
Rhea: if logic changes <200 LOC it's ideal. For larger PRs add a clear changelog section and split formatting/auto-fix commits. Use the PR template checklist.
Mira: reviewers: mention CODEOWNERS areas and add one senior reviewer from the team. If it's infra adjacent add `eng-infra` as a reviewer. Label with `area: console` `priority: low` etc.
Caleb: any tips for handling flaky CI? one flaky job failed on `e2e-login`.
Rhea: first re-run the job from the CI UI. If it fails consistently, paste the failing log snippet in the PR and add `flaky: investigate`. For transient flakes put `ci: re-run` in the comment after retry.
Mira: formatting: run `pre-commit run --all-files` and commit fixes separately. For import reordering we use `isort` + `black`.
Caleb: can someone pair for the review walkthrough? 20m would help me learn crit paths.
Rhea: I can do 20m at 3pm PT. Drop the PR link here and I'll join.
devex-bot: CI started for branch feat/ca/console-fix (job #5012) :robot_face:
